$comment: Maryland's two county minimum wages both step on July 1 -- the opposite cycle from the state rate, which has been flat at $15.00 since 2024. Prince George's County's ordinance was overtaken by the state rate and is not carried.

variants.test: In effect before the 2026-07-01 step to $18.00.

variants.label: Employers with 11-50 employees, January 1 - June 30, 2026
variants.test: In effect before the 2026-07-01 step to $16.50.

sources.title: Montgomery County, MD Office of Human Rights -- Minimum Wage Increase (July 1, 2026)
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session across the county's own press release and Office of Human Rights page: $18.00 large / $16.50 mid-size / $15.95 small, effective 2026-07-01 under the county's annual regional-inflation adjustment.

sources.title: Montgomery County, MD tipped-employee cash wage ($4.00/hr, Montgomery County Code Sec. 27-69)
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session across multiple independent summaries citing the county's own code section; found only after this project's ORIGINAL research pass had left Montgomery County's tipped rate unspecified and let it silently fall back to the state's $3.63 -- which understates every Montgomery County tipped worker's true cash floor by $0.37/hr. The county's own page did not render this specific figure on a direct fetch.

sources.title: Montgomery County, MD minimum wage rates in effect before the 2026-07-01 step
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session: large $17.65, mid-size $16.00, small $15.50 -- each increasing on 2026-07-01 (large +$0.35 to $18.00, mid-size +$0.50 to $16.50, small +$0.45 to $15.95).

tipped.note: Montgomery County Code Chapter 27 (Human Rights and Civil Liberties), Sec. 27-69 sets its OWN cash wage of $4.00/hr -- higher than the state's $3.63 -- applied against whichever of the county's three employer-size tiers covers this employer. maxTipCredit shown against the LARGE-employer $18.00 tier (the widest gap); the mid-size and small tiers have smaller credits against the same $4.00 cash floor.

jurisdictions.name: Howard County
jurisdictions.coverage: All employers. Howard County's small-employer tier (fewer than 15 employees) rose from $15.50 to $16.00 on 2026-07-01, UNIFYING the county on a single rate for the first time -- a table still carrying two Howard County rates is out of date.

sources.title: Howard County, MD -- Minimum Wage schedule (Finance Department)
sources.verifiedBy: Fetched and read directly this session at the county's own Finance Department page. Its own wage schedule table shows the small-employer tier reaching $16.00 on 2026-07-01, unifying with the county's single rate, and confirms that from 2027-01-01 onward increases are set by CPI-U rather than by council action.

sources.title: Howard County, MD tipped-employee minimum wage (permits the state's $3.63 cash wage)
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session: 'Howard County permits the same tip credit as Maryland state law -- employers must pay tipped employees at least $3.63 per hour, and the combination of cash wages and tips must equal or exceed the Howard County minimum wage rate.'

sources.title: Howard County, MD -- two-tier minimum wage structure before the 2026-07-01 unification
sources.verifiedBy: cross_source_confirmed this session: 'Small employers (fewer than 15 employees) began 2026 at $15.50 per hour, and large employers (15 or more employees) had to pay $16.00 per hour,' unifying to a single $16.00 rate for all employers on 2026-07-01.

tipped.note: Howard County permits the SAME cash wage as Maryland state law ($3.63/hr) -- unlike Montgomery County, which sets its own higher figure -- applied against the county's own (higher) standard rate.

variants.label: Employers with fewer than 15 employees, January 1 - June 30, 2026
variants.test: Howard County had TWO tiers through 2026-06-30 -- this one, and $16.00 for everyone else. They unified into a single $16.00 rate on 2026-07-01, which is why this file's own base entry carries no appliesWhen at all.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Labor Center -- Inventory of US City and County Minimum Wage Ordinances
sources.verifiedBy: Fetched and read directly this session. The standing national census of local minimum wage ordinances -- used here to establish WHICH jurisdictions exist (so none is silently omitted), with each rate then cross-checked against a second source.

knownGaps: Maryland tipped cash wages are set at the STATE level ($3.63); neither county publishes a separate tipped figure, so none is asserted here.
